contexts.text: Under Consummate, see these references. AC 4057.
All flesh shall not be cut off any more by the waters of a flood () = that they will not perish as the last posterity of the Most Ancient Church did.
I went down to the cuttings off of the mountains (). The Lord's temptations are thus described.

That soul shall be cut off from his peoples () = eternal death... Peoples = those who live in truths, that is, the Angels, and for the soul to be cut off from them is to be damned, or to perish in eternal death.
Desolation and vastation... are called cutting off, consummation, etc.

I will cut him off [i.e. the Amorite, etc.] () = when the Lord has protected against the evils and falsities which infest the Church, and has removed them... To cut off = to protect, and thus to remove: Hell is removed solely through the protection of Heaven by the Lord.
The writing was the writing of God cut out upon the tables ()... Cut out upon the tables = what is internal upon what is external, thus in it.
Exscindere occurs. AE 316:21.
Samaria is cut off (). Explained.
The horns of the altar shall be cut off (). Explained.
To cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper that remaineth () = that they have not any Knowledge of truth and good.
Under Cut, see this reference.
There shall not be cut off from David a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel () = that then the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord shall perpetually reign in the Church.
To hew out pits, broken pits which will not hold waters () = to hatch doctrinal things from man's Own intelligence...
The cuttings off of the mountains to which he went down = the Hell where and whence are evils.
Occurs.
Under Cistern, see this reference.
Whom Thou rememberest no more, and who are cut off from Thy hand () = who are deprived of all truth and good.
The land of cutting off, and the wilderness () = Hell.
Hewn stone () = those things which belong to man's Own intelligence: and as these things are signified by hewn stone, it was forbidden to build the altar of hewn stones, and also the temple.
He hewed out a winepress therein ().
Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches ().

The wood which he cuts down out of the forest, and the work of the hands of the workman with the axe () = evil, from which is worship, which has been fashioned from man's Own intelligence, through falsities...
